_note: The catalogue of everyday simple PC tasks (D54). Each entry: id, name, group, class (A ordinary; B only with the owner's own words; C always the PIN; ask = explained and not done), phrases (regular expressions; {kind:group} placeholders: item file folder text rest n app site when), examples (a phrase and the arguments it must give), how (a handler from plugins/desktop/simple_tasks.py plus its parameters), verify (what the PC is asked to confirm), needs_laptop (true = the real behaviour could only be checked on the laptop). Add a task by adding an entry that uses an existing handler: no code. The grant still comes from the owner's goal words in the kernel (policy.py); a catalogue entry never widens it.
